g.named: K · min_{0<=k<=K} Σ_i w_i w_{i+k} / (Σ_i w_i)^2, the minimum over 0 <= t <= 1 of the autocorrelation ∫ f(x) f(x+t) dx divided by (∫ f)^2 (attained at t = k/K; every lag summed exactly)

reference: the bar is the claimant's README print 0.41030211724 taken exactly (eleven digits), the only place this earlier certificate's bound is printed with its digits (the registry's 1c page says only that the K = 3072 certificate gives 0.4103021); the quantity is the certificate's minimum-autocorrelation ratio, the record's exact value 92043155785589760/224330199426578281 = 0.41030211723996994331…, which is BELOW the eleven-digit print by 3.0e-14: the certificate establishes 0.41030211723, not 0.41030211724; the record (row 1c-rozetyp-k3072) decided the registry's seven-digit 0.4103021 and certified it, so this object's bar is not the record's bar — kept as the claimant printed it
hypotheses: the definition on the 1c page: C_1c is the smallest constant with min_{0<=t<=1} ∫ f(x) f(x+t) dx <= C_1c (∫ f)^2 for every non-negative f in L^1, so one admissible f with ∫ f ≠ 0 gives C_1c >= its ratio (read)

for equal steps the autocorrelation is linear between consecutive multiples of 1/K, so its minimum over [0, 1] is attained at some t = k/K (read; [K2021, Thm 3.1] as the registry and the claimant cite it)
